response.overview: For fifteen years, he has led a lucrative life as a fisherman. Accompanied by his first mate, Etienne, Antoine doesn't hesitate to venture into the narrow channels that connect the Arcachon Basin to the Atlantic Ocean. One day, he suffers a sudden illness, after which an ophthalmologist informs him that he is losing his sight. To make matters worse, Etienne chooses this moment to leave him. That same evening, a young delinquent attempts to burglarize his home.
response.title: Le Regard de l'autre
